name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian drone strikes kill at least seven across six Ukrainian regions on 25 Nov; Ukraine hits three Russian refineries
state: Overnight to 25 Nov Russia launched 112 drones, 88 of which were downed, killing at least seven people in six regions, Ukraine's air force and officials said (Euronews). Deaths were reported in the Kyiv, Kharkiv, Zhytomyr and Donetsk regions, and a drone hit a minibus in Kharkiv region (112 Ukraine). Ukraine struck the Kuibyshev, Syzran and Novoshakhtinsk refineries and the Savasleyka airbase. Sustained mass strikes since the 19–20 Nov barrage keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets remain exposed to strikes on infrastructure.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes and attacks on energy infrastructure = Alert
